notes: All six pages have a single Common Crawl snapshot each (CC-MAIN-2021-39); no live copy was provided in the chunk, so sourceUrl is the Common Crawl index lookup address and sourceDate is the capture date. Ecole Polytechnique CRG: only page 1 of 5 of the paginated "Completed PhD theses at CRG" list was captured (five 2020 defenses); pages 2-5 (earlier theses) are not in the snapshot. listedYear is the defense-date year. MIT Sloan alumni page for Ed Roberts is a podcast transcript, not a placement list; one row recorded from the title line (PhD '62) and his own account of joining the MIT faculty in 1961. He is listed as faculty elsewhere; integrator should decide whether a 1962 MIT PhD belongs in the population. MIT Sloan "Recent Academic Placements": year is the PhD year as written ("PhD 2017"), destination is the institution where the page says the graduate is now; no titles. Group headings recorded as program; "Peter Hansen" and "Heather Yang" appear without the link spacing the others have but are listed the same way. Paris 1 ED Management thesis list: a doctoral-school list of defended theses across management fields (marketing, finance, HRM, information systems, etc.), not operations-specific; degree left null because the page only says "thèses soutenues". 2021 entries give no defense date and write names surname-first in capitals; 2020 entries give the defense date and an honorific (M./Mme.) which was dropped. All four 2021 entries are written title first, then supervisor, then the name; pairing follows that page order. University of Alabama Management PhD alumni page profiles a single graduate (Oscar Holmes IV, 2013); the listed position is current at page date, and the Q&A separately mentions a tenure-track job at Rutgers School of Business-Camden. University of Bristol PhD Job Market page lists eight current PhD students seeking jobs with no year and no placement (yearMeaning job-market, listedYear null); contact emails on the page were not copied. Only a minority are operations-adjacent (e.g. Bethany Sugg, fashion supply chains).
